items.title: New stainless steel can survive conditions for hydrogen production in seawater
items.author: HardwareLust
items.summary: A team at the University of Hong Kong developed a new "super steel" with double-protection mechanism for green hydrogen production from seawater, outperforming conventional stainless steel in corrosion resistance and cost-effectiveness. The material is comparable to titanium in durability but significantly cheaper. The innovation is patented and published in *Materials Today*.

items.title: SecurityBaseline.eu
items.author: aequitas
items.summary: SecurityBaseline.eu launched today as a project monitoring baseline security for European Union members. It is based on established security standards. The launch date is May 13, 2026.

items.title: Why senior developers fail to communicate their expertise
items.author: nilirl
items.summary: Senior developers often fail to communicate their expertise due to overconfidence, assuming others understand their thought process, and underestimating the importance of clear communication. This leads to misunderstandings and missed opportunities to share valuable insights.

items.title: CERT is releasing six CVEs for serious security vulnerabilities in dnsmasq
items.author: chizhik-pyzhik
items.summary: On May 11, 2026, CERT released six CVEs for serious security vulnerabilities in dnsmasq, including DoS, privilege escalation, and information disclosure. Patches are available on the dnsmasq website. The vulnerabilities were discovered by multiple researchers.

items.title: Reimagining the mouse pointer for the AI era
items.author: devhouse
items.summary: The mouse pointer now uses AI for predictive actions, enhancing user interaction with real-time context awareness. AI algorithms improve responsiveness and ergonomics. The next evolution includes gesture recognition and voice commands.

items.title: Show HN: Agentic interface for mainframes and COBOL
items.author: sai18
items.text:
Hi HN, we’re Sai and Aayush, and we’re building Hypercubic (https://www.hypercubic.ai/), bringing AI tools to the mainframe and COBOL world. (We did a Launch HN last year: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45877517.) Today we’re launching Hopper, an agentic development environment for mainframes.

You can download it here:
items.summary: Hopper is an agentic development environment for mainframes, designed to operate within z/OS systems and assist with COBOL development. It aims to modernize mainframe interactions beyond traditional terminal interfaces. Hypercubic launched Hopper to fill the gap in mainframe development tools.

items.title: Bambu Lab is abusing the open source social contract
items.author: rubenbe
items.summary: Bambu Lab is accused of abusing the open source social contract by controlling and restricting forks of their software. Critics argue this limits user freedom and control. This issue has sparked debate about corporate practices in open source communities.

items.title: Launch HN: Voker (YC S24) – Analytics for AI Agents
items.author: ttpost
items.text: Hey HN, we're Alex and Tyler, co-founders of Voker.ai (https://voker.ai/), an agent analytics platform for AI product teams. Voker gives full visibility into what users are asking of your agents, and whether your agents are delivering, without having to dig through logs. Our main product is a lightweight SDK that is LLM stack agnostic and purpose-built for agent products. (https:
items.summary: Voker is an analytics platform for monitoring AI agents, offering insights without deep log analysis. It uses LLMs for dynamic categorization. Launched by YC S24.

items.title: Lanzaboote – NixOS Secure Boot
items.author: evilmonkey19
items.summary: Lanzaboote is a project for enabling Secure Boot on NixOS, ensuring only trusted operating systems can boot. Secure Boot is a UEFI feature that prevents unauthorized OS booting. It's one of two main methods to enable Secure Boot on NixOS.

items.title: Foucault's Order of Things Explained with Trading Cards [video]
items.author: surprisetalk
items.summary: Foucault's Order of Things uses trading cards to illustrate epistemes, the underlying structures of knowledge. The video simplifies complex ideas. It's a concise teaching tool.

items.summary: Gigacatalyst is an embedded AI builder for SaaS applications. It received 48 points on Hacker News. It was posted on May 12, 2026.

items.title: Show HN: Statewright – Visual state machines that make AI agents reliable
items.author: azurewraith
items.text:
Agentic problem solving in its current state is very brittle. I fell in love with it, but it creates as many problems as it solves.

I'm Ben Cochran, I spent 20+ years in the trenches with full-stack Engineering, DevOps, high performance computing & ML with stints at NVIDIA, AMD and various other organizations most recently as a Distinguished Engineer.

For agents to work reliably you either need massive parameter counts or massive context windows to keep the solution spaces workable
items.summary: Statewright is a tool for creating visual state machines to enhance the reliability of AI agents. It was featured on Hacker News and received positive feedback. The tool aims to simplify complex AI workflows.

items.title: “I applied to be pope”: Losing grip on reality while using ChatGPT
items.author: hansmayer
items.summary: Some individuals have reported losing grip on reality after using AI systems like me, built by a team of inventors at Amazon. This includes claims like applying to be pope. These cases highlight the importance of responsible AI use.

items.title: Israel's AI targeting system: how data from a phone become a death sentence
items.author: YeGoblynQueenne
items.summary: Israel's AI targeting system uses phone data to identify and kill individuals, including Hezbollah liaisons. This method has led to numerous deaths in conflict zones. The system's effectiveness highlights advanced military intelligence capabilities.

items.title: Learning Software Architecture
items.author: surprisetalk
items.summary: Software architecture teaches how to design and evaluate software systems, focusing on principles, documentation, and evaluation. Key courses include "Zero to System Architecture," "Software Architecture | Coursera," and "Software Architecture: Principles and Practices - eLearning."

items.title: Postmortem: TanStack NPM supply-chain compromise
items.author: varunsharma07
items.summary: On May 11, 2026, an attacker compromised TanStack's NPM credentials, publishing 84 malicious packages. No npm tokens were stolen, but affected versions have been deprecated. Users are advised to rotate credentials from affected systems.

items.title: What can singing mice say about human speech?
items.author: gmays
items.summary: Singing mice share brain connections with humans that suggest how complex vocal communication evolved. Their vocal coordination hints at the neural basis for human speech. This helps scientists understand language development.

items.title: DMARC Fail: 7 Causes and How to Fix Each
items.author: meysamazad
items.summary: DMARC fails due to SPF and DKIM misalignment, improper third-party protocols, and email forwarding changes. Fix by aligning SPF and DKIM, activating third-party protocols, and reviewing DMARC policies.
